## Summary

Describe the change and the module boundary it affects.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant unit, integration, and/or end-to-end tests pass.
- [ ] Imports and configuration paths are valid.
- [ ] API or internal contract changes are documented.
- [ ] No identifying child data, raw video, secrets, private datasets, or model
      artifacts are included.
- [ ] Screening output remains explicitly non-diagnostic.
- [ ] New thresholds are configurable and their validation status is documented.

## Research and safety impact

Describe model, data, privacy, fairness, robot-safety, or screening-boundary
impacts, or state why none apply.
